title: Formation of the active Hermes transpososome is driven by asymmetric DNA binding of BED domains
authors: Laurie Lannes; Christopher M. Furman; Alison B. Hickman; Fred Dyda
one_liner_zh: 该文结合生化与结构方法研究Hermes转座酶八聚体与转座子DNA末端的非对称结合机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与动态机理研究，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但其多聚体组装与DNA识别策略对TF-DNA结合建模有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: The cut-and-paste Hermes DNA transposase stands out among the transposases that have been biochemically or structurally characterized so far. Many transposases function as dimers, but the Hermes transposase forms a tetramer of dimers to achieve its active form in vivo . Intriguingly, the transposition complex, or transpososome, relies on only one dimer to perform the enzymatic reactions necessary to the mobilization of its transposon. Our investigation combining biochemical and structural approaches shows that the Hermes octamer extensively interacts with its transposon left-end (LE) engaging the BED domains of three Hermes protomers belonging to three dimers. By contrast, the right-end (RE) is entirely deprived of such interaction inside the transpososome. Our work suggests that formation of the Hermes synaptic complex is sequential and relies on the considerable difference of affinity of the transposase towards its transposon ends. Thus, we propose that Hermes dimers multimerize to gather enough BED domains to find the LE among the abundant genomic DNA, facilitating the subsequent interaction with the RE, most likely solely based on recognition of its terminal inverted repeat.
abstract_zh: 剪切-粘贴型Hermes DNA转座酶在迄今已进行生化或结构表征的转座酶中脱颖而出。许多转座酶以二聚体形式发挥作用，但Hermes转座酶在体内通过形成二聚体的四聚体来达到其活性形式。有趣的是，转座复合体（或转座体）仅依赖一个二聚体来执行其转座子移动所需的酶促反应。我们的研究结合了生化和结构方法，表明Hermes八聚体与其转座子左端（LE）广泛相互作用，涉及来自三个二聚体的三个Hermes原聚体的BED结构域。相比之下，右端（RE）在转座体内完全缺乏这种相互作用。我们的工作表明，Hermes突触复合体的形成是顺序性的，并依赖于转座酶对其转座子末端亲和力的显著差异。因此，我们提出Hermes二聚体多聚化以聚集足够的BED结构域，在丰富的基因组DNA中找到LE，从而促进随后与RE的相互作用，这很可能仅基于对其末端反向重复序列的识别。
